values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead, same day included; DEC's 2026 summary sets a 1-night reservation minimum here. A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register by 9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

values.note: ReserveAmerica lists 189 campsites, equipment lengths 20-40 ft (95 at 30 ft, 24 at 40 ft); 4 pull-throughs (two 30 ft, two 40 ft), the rest back-in. Secluded, wooded sites.

summary: Confirmed $20 + $5 non-resident and the 2027 season (May 14-Oct 10 on RA; DEC 2026: May 15-Oct 12), ReserveAmerica 9-month window, 14-night max. Added 1-night minimum (DEC summary), 194 sites to 40 ft with 4 pull-throughs, no electric, showers/dump/spigots/vault toilets. Note (AWH) unchanged. Not stated: water/sewer at sites.
